This study assessed the real‐world effectiveness and safety of a fixed‐dose combination (FDC) of metformin and empagliflozin in Chinese patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).

This prospective, multicenter, real‐world study enrolled consecutive patients with T2DM treated with the FDC of metformin and empagliflozin between August 2023 and August 2025 across 50 clinical centers in China. The primary endpoint was the 6‐month glycemic clinical control rate (HbA1c < 7.0%).
